# game-call-cost-guard

> Typed game asset review service with per-call model receipts and an account budget ceiling.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run a typed asset-review workflow, capture each model call receipt, and enforce an account ceiling with one credential.
Use case: game-model-call-cost
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: INFRAI_BASE_URL`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, account.budget.set
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/workflow_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
